title: Cardinal Radcliffe: In age of AI, encourage young people to ask questions
script:
Cardinal Timothy Radcliffe is telling young people to keep asking questions.
The Vatican News reported his call for deeper curiosity during this AI era.
He worries that ready-made answers from technology might stifle our hunger for truth.
Radcliffe argues that the human spirit thrives when we search for meaning ourselves.
He insists we must help the next generation remain seekers rather than passive consumers.
Are you asking enough questions today?
